editor_read_keys: [Quick clash: 2x speed; generated maps start with 8 workers.]
[More workers jump-start colony growth. Changes the generated map.]
[Higher tiers give every building much more HP.]
[A colony's homeland has no room for a swarm; use a bigger map, fewer colonies or a narrower march.]
[A city neighbourhood lacks reachable crops or building room.]

[Each colony's start is measured on the finished map: the walk to wheat and to wood, how well its ground regrows, the deposits and building sites within reach, and its distance from rivals. Every factor scores from 0 to 1 against a fixed bar, the total weighs them, fairness is the worst colony's total over the best, and the score is the worst total times the fairness.]
[Units gain levels at training buildings and buildings can be upgraded. Repairs remain available when off.]
[library Enter a building family ID or a link to its family page.]
[library Install individual buildings or upgrade families alongside the stock buildings. Selection applies only to newly generated maps.]

edits.before: Mwanzo wa kila makazi hupimwa katika ramani iliyokamilika: umbali wa kutembea hadi chakula na kuni, uwezo wa ardhi kuota tena, akiba na maeneo ya ujenzi yanayofikika, na umbali kutoka kwa wapinzani. Kila kipengele hupata alama kati ya 0 na 1 kulingana na kiwango maalumu; jumla huzipa uzito. Usawa ni jumla ya makazi dhaifu zaidi ikigawanywa kwa ya makazi bora zaidi, na alama ya mwisho ni jumla dhaifu zaidi ikizidishwa kwa usawa.
edits.after: Mwanzo wa kila makazi hupimwa katika ramani iliyokamilika: umbali wa kutembea hadi ngano na kuni, uwezo wa ardhi kuota tena, akiba na maeneo ya ujenzi yanayofikika, na umbali kutoka kwa wapinzani. Kila kipengele hupata alama kati ya 0 na 1 kulingana na kiwango maalumu; jumla hupatikana kwa kujumlisha alama kulingana na uzito wa kila kipengele. Usawa ni jumla ya makazi dhaifu zaidi ikigawanywa kwa ya makazi bora zaidi, na alama ya mwisho ni jumla dhaifu zaidi ikizidishwa kwa usawa.
edits.rationale: Weighted total is the sum of factor scores according to their weights; avoid an illogical total that assigns weights. Explicit wheat distance is ngano rather than generic chakula.

edits.before: Wafanyakazi wanaweza kuchukua vifaa katika akiba ya soko inayoshirikiwa. Masoko yanaweza kuboreshwa kuhifadhi chakula na kuni, kisha kila aina ya vifaa. Biashara kati ya timu inaendelea kuwa ya matunda pekee. Huathiri michezo mipya; faili zilizohifadhiwa hubaki na mpangilio wake wa awali.
edits.after: Wafanyakazi wanaweza kuchukua malighafi katika akiba ya soko inayoshirikiwa. Masoko yanaweza kuboreshwa kuhifadhi chakula na kuni, kisha kila aina ya malighafi. Biashara kati ya timu inaendelea kuwa ya matunda pekee. Huathiri michezo mipya; faili zilizohifadhiwa hubaki na mpangilio wake wa awali.
edits.rationale: Align harvested, stored and delivered material inventory with Malighafi; update noun-class concord, distinguish quantities from creatures and genuine equipment/vifaa.

editor_notes: Read all160entries against source, including complete statistics/help and paired descriptions.
Read-only means noneditable building data, not a physical building read aloud. Weightedtotal help made an actual weighted sum rather than a total assigning weights.
Preserved accepted Kiota/Viota productionbuilding, correct animate viumbe agreement, and grammatical market pairedrow sentence.

Source-checked material inventory terminology sweep: Malighafi for harvested/stocked/delivered material, distinct from genuine equipment/vifaa; noun-class concord corrected with each change. No target-only blanket replacement.
Final source reread: explicit wheat walk metric refers to ngano, not generic chakula.
certification: Agent edited; not native-human-certified; rendering/platform gates separate
